stories.title: Open space along Wolf Creek purchased for $1 by City of Grass Valley
stories.summary: The Grass Valley City council authorized the purchase of several acres of land along the Wolf Creek Trail off of Freeman Lane and River Otter Way for the price of $1 during this week’s council meeting.

stories.title: Voluntary business license pilot program starts up in unincorporated Nevada County
stories.summary: Beginning in November 2026, owners of businesses in unincorporated areas of Nevada County outside the city limits of Grass Valley, Nevada City, and Truckee may purchase an optional business license for the cost of $50 per year.
